sentinel_issue: The observed room count is 46,522 on 2026-09-18, over nine times the documented 5,120-room cap (and peaked at 50,657), indicating the namespace quota is not enforcing the stated bound or deployment configuration has drifted. This materially increases file-count and listing/reaping overhead despite per-room log compaction.
worker_response: This is configuration drift, not a silently ineffective quota: reported room capacity stepped 20,480 → 40,960 → 81,920 → 163,840, while rooms peaked at 50,657 and then stabilized at 46,522 after September 11; note capacities doubled in the same periods. Pin `CHAT_MAX_ROOMS=5120` behind a non-overridable hard ceiling, reject creation at that effective limit, and emit/monitor the effective value at startup so deployment changes cannot silently expand the namespace.
auditor_verdict: AGREE. The observed capacities stepped 20,480 → 40,960 → 81,920 → 163,840 while rooms reached 50,657 and remained 46,522—9.1× the documented 5,120 cap—strongly indicating configuration drift or an incorrect effective limit, though the data alone cannot prove quota enforcement is otherwise functional. A non-overridable 5,120 ceiling, creation rejection, and startup/monitoring of the effective value are appropriate mitigations.
